description: This file exposes a set of command-line interfaces to interact with the configuration subsystem of a Git-like C project for testing purposes. It implements commands to retrieve configuration values, iterate over all configurations, and handle configuration files, providing detailed output for each operation.

methods.name: int iterate_cb(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * data UNUSED)
methods.description: Callback function invoked for each configuration key-value pair during iteration, printing key, value, origin, filename, line number, and scope.

methods.name: int parse_int_cb(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * data)
methods.description: Callback function used to parse and print integer configuration values matching a specific key.

methods.name: int early_config_cb(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx UNUSED,void * vdata)
methods.description: Callback function invoked during early configuration reading to print the value of a specific key.
